<?php

namespace App\Exceptions;

use Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use Symfony\Component\HttpKernel\Exception\MethodNotAllowedHttpException;
use Symfony\Component\HttpKernel\Exception\NotFoundHttpException;

/** Answers every error with the body of openapi.yaml: {"error": {"code", "message", "details"}}. */
final class ApiErrors
{
    public static function render(\Throwable $error): JsonResponse
    {
        return match (true) {
            $error instanceof ApiException => self::answer($error->status, $error->errorCode, $error->getMessage(), $error->details),
            $error instanceof ValidationException => self::answer(400, 'validation_error', 'The request is not valid', self::details($error)),
            $error instanceof NotImplementedException => self::answer(501, 'not_implemented', $error->getMessage() ?: 'The logic of this operation is not written yet'),
            $error instanceof NotFoundHttpException => self::answer(404, 'not_found', 'No route matches this request'),
            $error instanceof MethodNotAllowedHttpException => self::answer(405, 'method_not_allowed', 'This path does not accept this method'),
            default => self::unexpected($error),
        };
    }

    /** @param list<array{field: string, message: string}> $details */
    public static function answer(int $status, string $code, string $message, array $details = []): JsonResponse
    {
        $error = ['code' => $code, 'message' => $message];
        if ($details !== []) {
            $error['details'] = $details;
        }

        return response()->json(['error' => $error], $status);
    }

    /** @return list<array{field: string, message: string}> */
    private static function details(ValidationException $error): array
    {
        $details = [];
        foreach ($error->errors() as $field => $messages) {
            foreach ($messages as $message) {
                $details[] = ['field' => (string) $field, 'message' => $message];
            }
        }

        return $details;
    }

    private static function unexpected(\Throwable $error): JsonResponse
    {
        report($error);

        return self::answer(500, 'internal_error', 'Something went wrong on the server');
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Exceptions;

use RuntimeException;

/** An error the API answers with a status, a code and a message (see openapi.yaml). */
final class ApiException extends RuntimeException
{
    /** @param list<array{field: string, message: string}> $details */
    public function __construct(
        public readonly int $status,
        public readonly string $errorCode,
        string $message,
        public readonly array $details = [],
    ) {
        parent::__construct($message);
    }

    public static function invalid(string $field, string $message): self
    {
        return new self(400, 'validation_error', 'The request is not valid', [['field' => $field, 'message' => $message]]);
    }

    public static function unauthorized(): self
    {
        return new self(401, 'unauthorized', 'Missing or invalid credentials');
    }

    public static function forbidden(): self
    {
        return new self(403, 'forbidden', 'The credentials do not allow this operation');
    }

    public static function notFound(string $what): self
    {
        return new self(404, 'not_found', "No {$what} has this key");
    }

    public static function conflict(string $message): self
    {
        return new self(409, 'conflict', $message);
    }
}

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Exceptions\ApiException;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

/** Base of the controllers: the key in a path, read with its type. A malformed key is a 400, not a missing item. */
abstract class Controller
{
    protected function integerKey(string $value, string $name): int
    {
        if (preg_match('/^-?\d+$/', $value) !== 1) {
            throw ApiException::invalid($name, 'Must be a whole number');
        }

        return (int) $value;
    }

    protected function uuidKey(string $value, string $name): string
    {
        if (! Str::isUuid($value)) {
            throw ApiException::invalid($name, 'Must be a UUID');
        }

        return $value;
    }
}

    {

    /** List customers. */
    public function listCustomers(Request $request): Response
    {
        $query = $request->validate([
            'page' => ['sometimes', 'integer', 'min:1'],
            'size' => ['sometimes', 'integer', 'min:1', 'max:100'],
            'name' => ['sometimes', 'string'],
            'email' => ['sometimes', 'string'],
            'sort' => ['sometimes', Rule::in(['name', '-name', 'email', '-email'])],
        ]);
        $filters = [];
        if (array_key_exists('name', $query)) {
            $filters['name'] = $query['name'];
        }
        if (array_key_exists('email', $query)) {
            $filters['email'] = $query['email'];
        }
        $page = (int) ($query['page'] ?? 1);
        $size = (int) ($query['size'] ?? 20);

<?php

namespace App\Http\Requests;

use App\Exceptions\ApiException;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Http\FormRequest;
use Illuminate\Validation\Validator;

/**
 * Base of request bodies. The body must be a JSON object, and a field the contract does not describe is an
 * error, as in openapi.yaml (additionalProperties: false).
 */
abstract class ApiRequest extends FormRequest
{
    /**
     * Paths whose content is free (maps and values of any shape): nothing under them is checked. A "*"
     * stands for every item of a list.
     *
     * @var list<string>
     */
    protected array $open = [];

    public function authorize(): bool
    {
        return true;
    }

    protected function prepareForValidation(): void
    {
        $content = $this->getContent();
        $body = json_decode($content === '' ? 'null' : $content, true);
        if (json_last_error() !== JSON_ERROR_NONE) {
            throw new ApiException(400, 'validation_error', 'The body is not valid JSON');
        }
        if (! is_array($body) || (array_is_list($body) && $body !== [])) {
            throw new ApiException(400, 'validation_error', 'The body must be a JSON object');
        }
    }

    public function withValidator(Validator $validator): void
    {
        $validator->after(function (Validator $validator): void {
            $known = array_keys($this->rules());
            foreach ($this->unknownPaths($this->json()->all(), '', '', $known) as $path) {
                $validator->errors()->add($path, 'This field is not part of the contract.');
            }
        });
    }

    /**
     * Paths of the input that no rule describes. $pattern is the path with "*" for list items.
     *
     * @param  list<string>  $known
     * @return list<string>
     */
    private function unknownPaths(mixed $value, string $path, string $pattern, array $known): array
    {
        if (! is_array($value) || ($pattern !== '' && in_array($pattern, $this->open, true))) {
            return [];
        }
        $unknown = [];
        foreach ($value as $key => $item) {
            $itemPath = $path === '' ? (string) $key : "{$path}.{$key}";
            $itemPattern = ($pattern === '' ? '' : "{$pattern}.").(array_is_list($value) ? '*' : (string) $key);
            if (! in_array($itemPattern, $known, true)) {
                $unknown[] = $itemPath;

                continue;
            }
            array_push($unknown, ...$this->unknownPaths($item, $itemPath, $itemPattern, $known));
        }

        return $unknown;
    }
}

namespace App\Http\Resources;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Http\Resources\Json\JsonResource;

/** A customer as the API returns it: everything but what clients only send. */
final class CustomerResource extends JsonResource
{
    /** @return array<string, mixed> */
    public function toArray(Request $request): array
    {
        $item = $this->resource;

        return [
            'id' => $item['id'] ?? null,
            'name' => $item['name'] ?? null,
            'email' => $item['email'] ?? null,
            'phone' => $this->when(isset($item['phone']), fn () => $item['phone'] ?? null),
            'address' => self::object($item['address'] ?? null),
            'createdAt' => $item['createdAt'] ?? null,
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $item
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public static function one(array $item): array
    {
        return (new self($item))->resolve();
    }

    /**
     * @param  list<array<string, mixed>>  $items
     * @return list<array<string, mixed>>
     */
    public static function many(array $items): array
    {
        return array_map(self::one(...), $items);
    }

    /** An empty array is an empty JSON object here, not a list. */
    private static function object(mixed $value): mixed
    {
        return $value === [] ? new \stdClass() : $value;
    }
}

    /** @var array<int|string, array<string, mixed>> */
    private array $items = [];

    private int $nextKey = 1;

    public function list(ListQuery $query): ListResult
    {
        $items = array_values(array_filter($this->items, function (array $item) use ($query): bool {
            foreach ($query->filters as $field => $value) {
                if (! Values::same($item[$field] ?? null, $value)) {
                    return false;
                }
            }

            return true;
        }));
        if ($query->sortField !== null) {
            $field = $query->sortField;
            // Items without a value go last, whatever the order
            $present = array_values(array_filter($items, fn (array $item) => ($item[$field] ?? null) !== null));
            $missing = array_values(array_filter($items, fn (array $item) => ($item[$field] ?? null) === null));
            usort($present, fn (array $a, array $b) => $query->descending
                ? Values::compare($b[$field], $a[$field])
                : Values::compare($a[$field], $b[$field]));
            $items = [...$present, ...$missing];
        }

        return new ListResult(array_slice($items, $query->offset, $query->limit), count($items));
    }

    public function get(int $key): ?array
    {
        return $this->items[$key] ?? null;
    }

        $item['id'] = $this->nextKey++;
        $this->items[$item['id']] = $item;

        return $item;
    }

        $this->items[$key] = $item;

        return $item;

        unset($this->items[$key]);
    }

namespace App\Rules;

use Closure;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Validation\ValidationRule;

/**
 * Laravel skips its rules when a value is an empty or blank text ("", "  "). This rule checks those texts
 * against what the field declares: whether it is a text at all, its length, its pattern and its format.
 */
final class BlankString implements ValidationRule
{
    /** Runs even for blank values, which is all it is for */
    public bool $implicit = true;

    public function __construct(
        private readonly bool $text,
        private readonly ?int $min = null,
        private readonly ?int $max = null,
        private readonly ?string $pattern = null,
        private readonly bool $format = false,
    ) {
    }

    public function validate(string $attribute, mixed $value, Closure $fail): void
    {
        if (! is_string($value) || trim($value) !== '') {
            return;
        }
        $length = mb_strlen($value);
        if (! $this->text) {
            $fail('The :attribute field has the wrong type.');
        } elseif ($this->format) {
            $fail('The :attribute field must not be blank.');
        } elseif ($this->min !== null && $length < $this->min) {
            $fail("The :attribute field must be at least {$this->min} characters.");
        } elseif ($this->max !== null && $length > $this->max) {
            $fail("The :attribute field must not be greater than {$this->max} characters.");
        } elseif ($this->pattern !== null && preg_match($this->pattern, $value) !== 1) {
            $fail('The :attribute field format is invalid.');
        }
    }
}

/** What a list asks a repository for: equality filters by JSON field name, an order and a window of items. */
final class ListQuery
{
    /** @param array<string, mixed> $filters */
    public function __construct(
        public readonly array $filters = [],
        public readonly ?string $sortField = null,
        public readonly bool $descending = false,
        public readonly int $offset = 0,
        public readonly ?int $limit = null,
    ) {

    /**
     * "-createdAt" sorts by createdAt in descending order.
     *
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $filters
     */
    public static function of(array $filters, ?string $sort, int $offset = 0, ?int $limit = null): self
    {
        if ($sort === null || $sort === '') {
            return new self($filters, null, false, $offset, $limit);
        }
        $descending = str_starts_with($sort, '-');

        return new self($filters, $descending ? substr($sort, 1) : $sort, $descending, $offset, $limit);
    }
}

namespace App\Support;

/** Compares values as JSON does: a whole number equals the same number with decimals. */
final class Values
{
    public static function same(mixed $left, mixed $right): bool
    {
        if (is_numeric($left) && is_numeric($right) && ! is_string($left) && ! is_string($right)) {
            return $left == $right;
        }

        return $left === $right;
    }

    /** Texts in character order, numbers by value. */
    public static function compare(mixed $left, mixed $right): int
    {
        if (is_string($left) && is_string($right)) {
            return strcmp($left, $right);
        }

        return $left <=> $right;
    }
}

# shop-api

REST API generated by [Model2API](https://raulesteveza.github.io/tools/Model2API/) with Laravel. It is a starting point: review it before using it in production.

## Run it

Requires PHP 8.3 or later and Composer 2.

```bash
composer install
cp .env.example .env               # then fill in your values
php artisan serve
```

The API listens on http://localhost:8000. Its contract is in `openapi.yaml`.

## Test it

```bash
composer test
```


## Endpoints

| Method | Path | What it does | Success | Access |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/customers` | List customers | 200 | public |
| `GET` | `/customers/{id}` | Get a customer | 200 | public |
| `POST` | `/customers` | Create a customer | 201 | public |
| `PUT` | `/customers/{id}` | Replace a customer | 200 | public |
| `PATCH` | `/customers/{id}` | Update part of a customer | 200 | public |
| `DELETE` | `/customers/{id}` | Delete a customer | 204 | public |
| `GET` | `/products` | List products | 200 | public |
| `GET` | `/products/{id}` | Get a product | 200 | public |
| `POST` | `/products` | Create a product | 201 | public |
| `PUT` | `/products/{id}` | Replace a product | 200 | public |
| `PATCH` | `/products/{id}` | Update part of a product | 200 | public |
| `DELETE` | `/products/{id}` | Delete a product | 204 | public |
| `GET` | `/orders` | List orders | 200 | public |
| `GET` | `/orders/{id}` | Get an order | 200 | public |
| `POST` | `/orders` | Create an order | 201 | public |
| `PUT` | `/orders/{id}` | Replace an order | 200 | public |
| `PATCH` | `/orders/{id}` | Update part of an order | 200 | public |
| `DELETE` | `/orders/{id}` | Delete an order | 204 | public |
| `POST` | `/orders/{id}/action` | Business operation | 200 | public |

Errors always have the same body: `{"error": {"code": "...", "message": "...", "details": [...]}}`. Invalid requests answer 400.

## Storage

Data is kept in memory while the application runs and is lost when it stops. Write another implementation of each repository interface and bind it in `app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php`.

## Authentication

Every endpoint is public.

## Structure

```text
app/
  Http/Controllers/      HTTP routes of each resource
  Http/Requests/         request bodies and their validation
  Http/Resources/        responses
  Services/              rules of each resource
  Repositories/          storage
  Enums/                 enums
routes/api.php           every route and its protection
tests/Feature/           one test class per resource
openapi.yaml             the contract of the API
```

## Left to you

- `POST /orders/{id}/action` (Business operation): write its logic in the service; it answers 501 until then.

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use Tests\TestCase;
use Tests\TestData;

/** Tests of the customers endpoints. */
final class CustomerApiTest extends TestCase
{
    use TestData;

    public function test_creates_a_customer(): void
    {
        $payload = $this->customerPayload();

        $response = $this->postJson('/customers', $payload, $this->headers());

        $response->assertStatus(201);
        $body = $response->json();
        $this->assertArrayHasKey('id', $body);
        $this->assertSame($payload['name'], $body['name']);
        $this->assertSame($payload['email'], $body['email']);
        $this->assertSame($payload['phone'], $body['phone']);
    }

    public function test_rejects_a_customer_without_name(): void
    {
        $payload = $this->customerPayload();
        unset($payload['name']);

        $response = $this->postJson('/customers', $payload, $this->headers());

        $response->assertStatus(400);
        $this->assertSame('validation_error', $response->json('error.code'));
        $this->assertContains('name', array_column($response->json('error.details'), 'field'));
    }

    public function test_gets_a_customer(): void
    {
        $created = $this->createCustomer();
        $key = $created['id'];

        $response = $this->getJson('/customers/'.$key, $this->headers());

        $response->assertStatus(200);
